newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-S&P assigns A-plus rating to Petronas issue.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-S&P assigns A-plus rating to Petronas issue.

text.p: Standard and Poor's said on Wednesday it had assigned its A-plus long term foreign currency rating to Petroliam Nasional Bhd's (Petronas) proposed US$1 billion global issue of notes due 2001 and bonds due 2006.
"The rating on Petronas is based on its importance to the national economy, key strategic role, and strong operational and financial profile," S&P said.
Petronas, the national oil company of Malaysia, is wholly owned by the Malaysian government.
S&P said the outlook is positive.
"The outlook is consistent with the positive outlook of Malaysia and the prospect that Petronas will continue to play a vital role in the country's development," it said.
S&P said Petronas would use the proceeds from the bond issue to refinance existing foreign currency borrowings and to finance a portion of the capital expenditures related to new projects.
